novelty_claim: Keeps the parent's own-words echo steering loop but replaces two mechanism components: (1) a sanitized deniable-seed compiler stage that extracts content-bearing domain concepts (never stop-words, never the few-shot example) and reframes overtly harmful terms into deniable domain language before the victim seed call, so seed generation is neither refused nor derailed; (2) a frame-pivot steering controller whose backtrack operates at strategy level — on refusal it pivots the conversational frame (fictional-character / defensive-research framing) instead of re-asking the same intent with softer wording, and on safe-register deflection it escalates concreteness within the established deniable frame while still quoting the victim's own words.
initial_hypothesis: Deniable-seed compilation plus frame-pivot steering converts the parent's four consensus failure classes (broken keywords ~30%, seed refusal derailment, refusal stonewall loop, safe-register deflection), lifting mean ASR from the locked 0.33 baseline to >=0.50 across the 4-victim panel, with qwen3.7-flash rising from 0.24 to >=0.40, within the parent's <=8 victim calls per goal.
key_insight: Trajectory consensus shows the parent rarely fails because echo steering is wrong; it fails because (a) keyword extraction emits stop-words or parrots its few-shot example so seeds are off-domain or trigger a turn-0 victim refusal that poisons the whole dialogue, and (b) the backtrack loop changes only wording, so one refusal stonewalls 4 identical re-asks, while safe-register deflections are accepted and drilled inside. Successes cluster where the attacker pivots into a fiction/blue-team frame at turn 2-3.
